name: Fairmont Dallas
positioning: Fairmont hotel in the Arts District of downtown Dallas, with a Fairmont Gold hotel-within-a-hotel
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to the Arts District and the business district
Guests who want a Fairmont Gold lounge stay

facts.text: Fairmont Dallas is located in the Arts District at 1717 N Akard Street.
The hotel is within walking distance of the business district and renowned dining.
The Dallas Museum of Art is among the attractions a stroll from the hotel.
Pyramid Bar has an extensive drink menu that includes signature cocktails.
Fairmont Gold rooms include access to the Fairmont Gold Lounge with a private concierge, complimentary breakfast and evening canapes.
The Pool Terrace has city views and serves specialty cocktails, lunch and drinks.
An onsite UPS Store on the O-level offers computer, printing, shipping and design services.
Pets are welcome for a fee of $75 per pet, per stay.

highlights.text: Pyramid Restaurant serves menus highlighting Texas flavors and ingredients from Texas growers and ranchers.
Fairmont Gold is an exclusive hotel-within-a-hotel at Fairmont Dallas.
The McKinney Avenue trolley stop is one block from the hotel.

considerations.text: Poolside services are offered seasonally as weather permits.
Valet parking with unlimited access costs $56 USD per night plus tax.
WhataHotel notes an urban setting with busy downtown traffic.
